key_insight: REE evaluates autonomous scientific research through iterative improvement, with two tested agents outperforming expert solutions on more than 80% of problems.
engineering_relevance: REE offers a unified way to compare research agents against established scientific methods under comparable evaluation conditions.
method: Use 100 expert-reviewed, open-ended problems spanning five scientific areas and 23 domains.
Give agents up to 12 hours to improve a working starter solution.
Score improvements against established expert solutions on a common scale.
evidence_signal: Among four frontier agents evaluated, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol outperformed expert solutions on 86% and 81% of problems, respectively, surpassing them within two hours on average.
watch_item: Benchmark improvements should not be equated with novel scientific discovery: the strongest solutions mostly tailored or combined established methods.
paper_title: REE: A Scientific Research Entrance Exam for AI Agents
